family: finite disjoint products of genuine Boolean point defects q_n

packet.scope: complete conditional-label plus phase selector packet against a constant

interaction.reason: For every fixed r>=3, the equal-factor r-way interaction is c_r*delta^2+O_r(delta^3 log(1/delta)) with c_r nonzero.

ownership.order: any fixed deterministic total order pi on factors
ownership.owner_rule: owner(B) is the earliest element of B in pi
ownership.owner_total: For stage A_j, sum of interactions owned by i_j equals R(A_j)-R(A_{j+1}).
ownership.physical_realization: exhaust q_{n_i_j} before proceeding to the next factor

equal_factor_asymptotics.warning: higher interactions are order delta^2, not delta^r

tests.near_tensors: all finite disjoint products in the declared family
tests.rare_activation: fresh activation scales all conditional reached terms by the same reach probability; its own control packet remains separate
tests.prime_gates: each q_n is an AND/OR-type prime gate up to signs and relabeling
tests.parity_zero_erasure: not used; complete L+Q packet retained

remaining_obligation: Find an order or stopping rule for which total positive credits plus final terminals are bounded by a dimension-independent multiple of nonreused influence, first uniformly for arbitrarily many point-defect factors and then for general Boolean branching trees.
